task_grounding:
Audacity is open with /home/user/Music/ambient.aup already loaded. The project contains a single wavetrack named 'Ambient Pad' and has no metadata tags set.

Open Edit > Metadata... and fill in the following tag values exactly:
- Title: Ocean Drift
- Artist: Mika Lee
- Album: Coastal
- Year: 2024
- Genre: Ambient
- Comments: A short demo recording for testing

Click OK to close the metadata dialog, then save the project (File > Save Project, or Ctrl+S) so the tags are persisted inside the .aup XML at /home/user/Music/ambient.aup. Do not rename the file and do not change any track or project settings.

verification.description: Project file is still a valid .aup
